zh-CN.name: 故事叙事型
zh-CN.description: 用有因果与顺序的内容叙事介绍问题、探索过程和结果，引导用户理解产品的意义。它是一种信息表达方式，不要求强制滚动或连续动画。
use_when: 产品背景或案例过程需要逐步理解。
有真实素材能支持完整叙事。
avoid_when: 赶时间的用户仍应能直达功能或结果。
不要以强制滚动与自动播放代替信息组织。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 按问题、过程和结果组织内容，给每段一个清楚的小标题与证据；提供目录或直达主操作的入口；动效只辅助段落关系，减少动态效果时仍能完整阅读。

en.name: Storytelling-Driven
en.description: A content approach that connects a problem, exploration and outcome in a meaningful sequence. It helps explain product significance without requiring forced scrolling or continuous animation.
use_when: The product background or case process benefits from a sequence.
avoid_when: Time-sensitive users should still reach features or outcomes directly.
Do not substitute scroll hijacking or autoplay for information structure.
en.prompt_template: Organize content around the problem, process and outcome, with clear section headings and evidence. Provide a contents route or direct access to the primary action. Use motion only to support relationships, and keep the story complete when motion is reduced.
